title: V.O.C. Port Becomes India’s First Scope-2 Emission-Free Major Port
summary: V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, became India’s first major port to achieve Scope-2 Emission-Free status on 10 August 2026. The port also became the first in India to secure ISO 50001:2018 certification for its ...

blocks.content: V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, became India’s first major port to achieve Scope-2 Emission-Free status on 10 August 2026. The port also became the first in India to secure ISO 50001:2018 certification for its Energy Management System.

items: V.O. Chidambaranar Port is located in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, and it is one of India’s major ports.
Scope-2 emissions are indirect emissions linked to purchased electricity and other energy services.
ISO 50001:2018 is the international standard for energy management systems.
Battery storage is often used with solar and wind power to balance variable renewable generation.
